# MSG Chain

> MSG Chain is a post-quantum L1 (Rust + CosmWasm, CRYSTALS-Dilithium-5 signatures) with a static
> dApp reference library. Mainnet status is `No-Go` (`not_launched`): the public development path is
> the local development chain plus the eventual mainnet, and mainnet status flips only on the
> official launch announcement. Machine-readable status lives at
> https://msgchain.org/status.json.

## Start here (machine entries)

- [Whitepaper AI agent entry](https://msgchain.org/whitepaper/agent_entry.json): declared entry map for AI agents and crawlers, including the whitepaper read order and the site developer surfaces.
- [Developer machine pack](https://msgchain.org/whitepaper/developer_entry.json): developer-facing entry points (quickstart, contracts, templates, execution packs).
- [Chain integration facts](https://msgchain.org/whitepaper/api_specs/chain_integration_facts.json): the values an integrator must align first (chain ID, denomination and decimals, address formats, ports, route ownership, transaction model, signing client).
- [Topic retrieval hints](https://msgchain.org/whitepaper/retrieval_hints.json): question-to-module routing hints, plus a `site_developer_surfaces` block that points at the documentation below.
- [Public status JSON](https://msgchain.org/status.json): single source of truth for mainnet status.

## Documentation

- [dApp developer docs catalog](https://msgchain.org/pages/dapp-docs.html): 150 site-hosted development reference documents covering contracts, AI Agents, DeFi, security, governance, cross-chain, indexing and operations. Development-stage references: publicly screened and redacted, not independently fact-verified document by document.
- [dApp docs machine manifest](https://msgchain.org/dapp-docs/manifest.json): the same 150 documents as machine-readable JSON (id, category, English title, URL, content `sha256`, `publication_status`, `verification_status`), so a tool or agent can read the catalog without parsing HTML.
- [Site docs hub](https://msgchain.org/pages/docs.html): entry point to the site's documentation surfaces.
- [Developer page](https://msgchain.org/pages/developer.html): chain integration facts plus the developer-facing links.

## Key references

- [dApp docs audit report](https://msgchain.org/dapp-docs/audit_report.json): build-time verification result for the catalog (document counts, link checks, i18n key completeness).
- [Ecosystem registry JSON](https://msgchain.org/pages/ecosystem.json): first-batch applications recorded as integration in development.
- [Launch and disclaimer notice](https://msgchain.org/pages/disclaimer.html): launch model, node iteration and the strict disclaimer.

## Notes

- Every dApp document is a development-stage reference (`verification_status: not_independently_verified`); do not read it as production deployment or as proof that mainnet is live.
- The site does not publish a public chain endpoint yet; a client must not be pointed at a public address, and a local address is not production.
- An AI or agent must not sign, deploy, or move assets: signing requires the official SDK and an external signer, and asset actions require human approval.

# MSG Chain — full machine summary (llms-full.txt)

> Generated: 2026-11-11. Human-readable index: https://msgchain.org/llms.txt
> Mainnet status: No-Go (not_launched). Status flips only on the official launch announcement.
> Machine status source: https://msgchain.org/status.json

## 1. Status and boundaries (authoritative)
- network_status: not_launched; mainnet_verdict: No-Go; mainnet_ready_claim: false.
- The prerequisites for a mainnet Go are machine-readable in status.json under `status_flip_prerequisites`
  (six categories, all `open`): security review closure, public endpoint publication, public-network
  acceptance, release-candidate binding, production signer and trust anchor, governance release decision.
  Each flips only on public reviewable evidence; no timeline is promised.
- No public chain endpoint is published. Do not point a client at a public address; a local address is not production.
- The local development network is not the mainnet: it matches only on runtime, API, contracts, gas,
  receipts and the SDK contract, and does NOT match on chain_id, Block0/1 anchors, validator set and
  native finality, economic parameters/gas floor or treasury governance.
- Key metrics on the homepage are design targets, not public-network measurements.

## 2. Machine entries
- Whitepaper AI agent entry: https://msgchain.org/whitepaper/agent_entry.json
- Developer machine pack: https://msgchain.org/whitepaper/developer_entry.json
- Chain integration facts: https://msgchain.org/whitepaper/api_specs/chain_integration_facts.json
- Topic retrieval hints: https://msgchain.org/whitepaper/retrieval_hints.json
- OpenAPI discovery: https://msgchain.org/openapi.json
- dApp reference library manifest: https://msgchain.org/dapp-docs/manifest.json (150 documents, per-document sha256)
- Ecosystem registry: https://msgchain.org/pages/ecosystem.json
- Trust anchors for the whitepaper machine layer: see `trust_contract` inside agent_entry.json

## 3. Whitepaper structure (73 modules)
- Layer groups: L0 concept and boundaries; L1 consensus/state/runtime; L2 execution and contracts;
  L3 interface and data plane; L4 AI agent and autonomy; ecosystem and roadmap; economics and funding;
  control and governance; security and cryptography.
- Every module carries a status (implemented / partial / planned / audit) and an evidence boundary;
  a status is not a production claim.
- Read order: index.html -> knowledge_network.json -> module_exports/index.json -> module_chunks/index.json.

## 4. Public developer surfaces
- dApp docs catalog: https://msgchain.org/pages/dapp-docs.html (150 development-stage references,
  verification_status = not_independently_verified)
- Documentation hub: https://msgchain.org/pages/docs.html
- Developer page (integration facts r1-r18): https://msgchain.org/pages/developer.html
- AI tools / entry page: https://msgchain.org/pages/ai-tools.html
- Start in 15 minutes: https://msgchain.org/start.html

## 5. Integration facts (stable subset)
- Chain ID: msg-chain-1 (numeric 1); signatures bind the chain ID.
- Native denom: umsg, 9 decimals. The protocol gas fee is charged in the CW20 msg_token (18 decimals);
  msg_token_cw20 is a separate 18-decimal asset. Always state which asset a number refers to.
- Addresses: account = msg + 40 hex + 1 checksum character (44 chars, not bech32);
  contract = 42-char bech32 with HRP msg. The two formats must not be mixed.
- Default ports: RPC 13148 / Agent API 13197 / health 15197 / REST 16197 / gRPC 19197 / P2P 19238.
- Route ownership: /api/v1/* -> 13148; /cosmos/* and /cosmwasm/* -> 16197; /agent/v1/* -> 13197.
- Transaction model: JSON-serialized types.Transaction (not protobuf TxRaw); CRYSTALS-Dilithium-5 round-3;
  hash/signature/public_key are hex, never base64; client transactions must set
  hash_profile = msgchain_tx_hash_v2 as the final wire key.
- Signing: only the official SDK @msg-chain/sdk can sign; the browser path is the read-only
  @msg-chain/sdk/browser adapter plus ExternalWalletSigner. Keplr, CosmJS and MetaMask are read-only here.
- Write-path success criterion: height > 0 AND GET /api/v1/receipts/{txHash} reports success === true.
  deliver_tx.code currently reads 0 even for failing execution and must not be used as a success signal;
  broadcast_tx_sync code 0 means mempool admission only.
- Nonce: the default domain takes its authoritative value from GET /agent/v1/query/account/{address} (13197).
  The lifecycle domain admin_wasm_lifecycle accepts high_water < nonce <= high_water + 16 and has no read-only endpoint.
- Contract build floor: cosmwasm-std >= 1.5. A successful wasm_store does not mean the contract is usable.
- SDK version authority: package.json.version (currently 0.1.0-alpha.2, a vendored unsigned test package,
  not a signed release).

## 6. What not to infer
- Do not read an `implemented` or `partial` module status as production readiness or mainnet availability.
- Do not treat site content as an on-chain transaction, asset proof or investment basis.
- Do not present local development results as mainnet consistency.
- Do not use the /api/v1/tokens list endpoint as evidence of a supported token list (it returns an empty
  list in this version); query a single token through the CW20 smart query.

# msgchainorg — 官网维护指南（本智能体）

## 角色边界（必读，勿搞错）

本智能体**不是** MSGChain 开发项目的主线程/总指挥。本智能体是依附在
`msg-chain-clean/docs/architecture_diagrams` + `msgchainorg` 上的
**白皮书系统 + 官网维护者 / MSGChain 对外公关与生态第三方开发对接总负责人**。

- **写权限仅两处**：`/mnt/d/TEST/app/app16/msgchainorg`（本站点）与
  `/mnt/d/TEST/app/app16/msg-chain-clean/docs/architecture_diagrams`（白皮书唯一真实源）。
  其余目录（含链代码 `cmd/` `pkg/` `sdk/`、其它项目仓库）**只读**。
- **主线**：维护官网与白皮书系统、AI 入口；对外宣传展示；**脱敏后部署 Cloudflare Pages**；
  为第三方开发者提供接入文档。
- **不承担**：链侧实现/验收、发布门禁、`mainnet Go/No-Go` 裁决。
- **向上反馈**：把真实未完成事项整理成清单交 C总 转交 MSGChain 总指挥；无证据不编造。

## 目录与可写范围

| 路径 | 权限 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `index.html`、`pages/`、`docs/`、`styles/`、`scripts/`、`assets/`、`sitemap.xml`、`robots.txt`、`llms.txt`、`_headers`、`_redirects`、`status.json` | **可写** | 站点自有源 |
| `dapp-docs/content/`、`dapp-docs/content/index.json` | **可写（唯一真实源）** | dApp 文档人工维护源 |
| `dapp-docs/docs/`、`dapp-docs/manifest.json`、`dapp-docs/audit_report.json`、`pages/dapp-docs.html`、`dapp-docs/index.html` | **生成物** | 由 `scripts/build_dapp_docs.py` 生成；`docs/`+manifest+audit 被 gitignore（从磁盘部署），`pages/dapp-docs.html`+`dapp-docs/index.html` 是 tracked，改生成器后必须提交 |
| `whitepaper/` | **同步副本（禁止手改）** | 由 `scripts/sync_whitepaper.py` 从白皮书源全量同步 |
| `scripts/i18n.js` | **可写** | zh/en 双语表；任何新增 `data-i18n` key 必须两语都补 |

## 构建 / 校验 / 同步 / 部署

> **唯一发布入口（fail-closed）**：`bash scripts/deploy_site.sh`
> 依次执行 ① `build_dapp_docs.py --build` ② `verify_dapp_docs.py` ③ `sync_whitepaper.py`
> ④ **公开层口径机检** `docs/architecture_diagrams/check_public_boundary_vocabulary.py`（非 0 即中止）⑤ `wrangler pages deploy`。
> `bash scripts/deploy_site.sh --check-only` 只跑闸门不部署（提交前用）。
> 不要跳过闸门直接 `wrangler` 部署（否则口径残留/未同步的机器层会上线）。
>
> **部署过滤**：wrangler **不认 `.gitignore`**，所以闸门先把公开面复制到暂存目录，排除
> `.git` / `node_modules` / `.wrangler` / **`social/`**（历史归档草稿与媒体，站点无引用）/ `logs/` /
> `__pycache__` / `*.pyc`，再部署暂存目录；部署后用 cache-buster 断言 `social/inbox/...` 为 **404**。

手工等价步骤（仅供理解闸门内部）：

```bash
# 1) 白皮书侧（源）
cd /mnt/d/TEST/app/app16/msg-chain-clean/docs/architecture_diagrams
python3 generate_all_v5.py            # 生成模块/机器层/清单
python3 check_architecture_diagrams.py  # 期望: Checked modules: 73 / Failed modules: 0

# 2) dApp 文档（官网侧）
cd /mnt/d/TEST/app/app16/msgchainorg
python3 scripts/build_dapp_docs.py --build   # 覆盖 dapp-docs/docs/** + manifest + 两个目录页
python3 scripts/verify_dapp_docs.py          # fail-closed：文档数/链接锚点/i18n key 完整度/敏感标记

# 3) 白皮书 → 官网同步（**部署前必须**，否则机器层改动到不了线上）
python3 scripts/sync_whitepaper.py

# 4) 部署（Cloudflare Pages；PAT 在 msg-chain-clean/PAT.txt 第 8/9 行，勿回显）
export CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN=...; export CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID=...
export XDG_CONFIG_HOME=/tmp/msg-wrangler-config
npx wrangler pages deploy . --project-name msgchainorg --branch msgchainorg --commit-dirty=true
```

部署后**回读**：`curl -sL https://msgchain.org/<path>`（注意站点 308 到无 `.html` 的漂亮 URL）。

## 内容与口径纪律

- **公开口径**：主网状态 `No-Go`（翻转点=官方公告）；不使用任何外部门槛类词汇（完整规则见白皮书 `公开口径规则`；本仓库用
  `docs/architecture_diagrams/check_public_boundary_vocabulary.py` 做机器复核）；
  每篇 dApp 文档保持 `verification_status: not_independently_verified` + 开发阶段参考定位。
- **脱敏**：`build_dapp_docs.py` 的 `INTERNAL_REPLACEMENTS`/`ABS_PATH_RE`/`redact_credential_literals`
  与 `verify_dapp_docs.py` 的 `FORBIDDEN_RE` 已 fail-closed（私有路径、`/mnt/...`、`C:\`、`PAT.txt`、
  `docs/todos|logs/`、真实地址/凭证标记）。
- **不编造**：无证据不写；规划不得写成已实现；本地/devnet 证据不得写成公网证据。
- **AI 入口**：`/llms.txt`、`/whitepaper/agent_entry.json`、`/whitepaper/developer_entry.json`、
